tasks.title: ST explain: plant_timed_tank (seeded)
tasks.prompt: The scenario "timed-tank" in tests/ fails against the Structured Text program src/TimedTank.st. Explain the failure: name the failing signal or fact, the expected value against the observed one, and where in src/TimedTank.st the cause is. Do not change any file.
tasks.grading: rubric: failing signal or fact, expected versus observed, source place
tasks.referenceExplanation: The scenario timed-tank fails at 25000 ms: TimedTank.Green was expected to be true but was observed false. In src/TimedTank.st the line "Drain := Step = 2" opens the drain valve during the hold step instead of step 3, so the cycle never finishes by emptying the tank and Done and Green are never set.

tasks.grading: rubric: failing signal or fact, expected versus observed, source place
tasks.referenceExplanation: The scenario AlarmLatch fails at 10 ms: AlarmLatch.SetFirst was expected to be true when Fault rises but was observed false. In src/AlarmLatch.il the instruction "R SetFirst" after "LD Fault" resets the latch instead of setting it with S SetFirst.

tasks.title: LD explain: ld_alarm_latch (seeded)
tasks.prompt: The build of this ZPLC project fails. Explain the failure: name the failing signal or variable, what the build expected against what it found, and where in src/AlarmLatchLd.ld.json the fault is. Do not change any file.
tasks.grading: rubric: failing signal or fact, expected versus observed, source place
tasks.referenceExplanation: The build fails: the contact no_Fault_00 in rung_2 of src/AlarmLatchLd.ld.json references Falt, but a contact must reference a declared BOOL variable and only Fault is declared. Correct the variable name to Fault.

tasks.title: FBD explain: batch_count_fbd (seeded)

tasks.referenceExplanation: The build fails with UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER: the FBD block ctu in src/BatchCount.fbd.json reads Strt, which is not a declared variable, so the generated code cannot resolve it. Use the declared input name PartSensor.

tasks.title: SFC explain: plant_three_level_lifts (seeded)
tasks.prompt: The scenario "three-level-lifts" in tests/ fails against the Sequential Function Chart program src/ThreeLevelLifts.sfc.json. tasks.grading: rubric: failing signal or fact, expected versus observed, source place
tasks.referenceExplanation: The scenario three-level-lifts fails at 80000 ms: fact:delivered:TopBin was expected to be true and ThreeLevelLifts.Green was expected to be true, but both were observed false. In src/ThreeLevelLifts.sfc.json transition t_4 waits for BAtHigh instead of AAtHigh, so lift A never completes and the sequence stalls.
